metadata.title: Milnor's inequality and circular elastic knots
metadata.abstract: We establish the extension of Milnor's inequality, relating total curvature with the bridge index, to the $C^1$-closure of a knot class, without any restriction on the self-intersections of the limit curve. Together with recent work of Reiter--von der Mosel, this resolves the circular elastic knot conjecture, first predicted by Gallotti--Pierre-Louis in 2007 and then formulated as a mathematical conjecture by Gerlach--Reiter--von der Mosel in 2017. More precisely, if the bridge and braid indices of a tame knot class coincide, then the multiply covered circle is the unique elastic knot.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 把联系总曲率与桥数的 Milnor 不等式延拓到结类的 C¹ 闭包，不限制极限自交；结合既有结果证明桥数等于辫数时多重圆是唯一弹性结。
analysis.breakthrough: 处理极限自交并解决所述圆形弹性结猜想。
analysis.limitations: 唯一性结论保留 tame 结类及桥数等于辫数条件。
analysis.priorityReason: 处理极限自交并解决所述圆形弹性结猜想。
